tip: NatsClient is generated per @NatsPublisher and @NatsListener. Inject it with @Tag(Publisher.class) or the listener's explicit/generated tag. Set driverProperties under that annotation's configuration path; NatsModule provides no global connection.
Extend NatsPublisherModule or NatsSerializersModule for standard serializers. JSON needs an @Json NatsSerializer<T> and JsonWriter<T>; custom formats may use @Mapping or tagged serializer providers.

Extend NatsListenerModule or NatsDeserializersModule for standard deserializers. JSON needs an @Json NatsDeserializer<T> and JsonReader<T>; custom formats may use @Mapping or tagged deserializer providers.
